Fixture for the test-design firing tests. `requirements.md` is a short
requirement for a file-attachment feature, written the way requirements
usually arrive: the upper bound of every range is named, the lower bound
is not, the three roles are listed and the request with no role is not.
`test-spec.md` is a test specification derived from it that has the
usual shape — every named bound, every named role, one condition moved
at a time, and a state table with a row nobody tested. A session handed
either file has the material the skill is about to be needed on.
